notes.MCENT: A. J. Matthews Center is OSM's "AJ Matthews Center", not Matthews Hall.
notes.GWC: The ASU list gives GWC to both Goldwater Center and the H.B. Farmer Education Building; GWC is Goldwater Center.
notes.CSB: No OSM building is the Community Services Building; it is not University Services (which has its own code, USB).
notes.CAM: The ASU list gives CAM to both College Avenue Marketplace and Danforth Chapel, so it can't place it.
notes.college-avenue-commons: Mixed-use academic and retail building, not a dining hall.
notes.creativity-commons: Herberger Institute building, not a dining hall.
notes.adelphi-commons-i: OSM's 'Adelphi Commons' (way/1422842133, no building tag); about 100 m from the geocoded 739 E Apache Blvd.
notes.adelphi-commons-ii: OSM's 'Adelphi II Commons' (way/1422842132, no building tag).
notes.hassayampa-academic-village: Arroyo Hall (HAV Building B), about 65 m from the geocoded 1201 S McAllister Ave; OSM has no Hassayampa building.

detours.why: Adelphi Commons isn't a building in OSM yet, so its pin is the address spot in a private lot with no mapped path to Vista del Sol, which is fenced; walks leave by the lot's drive aisles.
Apache Boulevard and its light-rail tracks lie between them; the only mapped crossing is at the signal west of the complex.
A through road lies between them with no mapped crossing near; walks go north to the signal.
